skills.name: define-design
skills.title: Design brief
skills.description: Write a design brief from developer instructions. Use before a new interface or a change to its visual identity.

skills.name: create-design-md
skills.title: Design file
skills.description: Write DESIGN.md from a design brief. Use when the project must have a design file with tokens and interface instructions.

skills.name: extract-design
skills.title: Design extraction
skills.description: Record design data from source code, an interface, or images. Use to make DESIGN.md for an available interface.

skills.name: review-design-md
skills.title: Design file inspection
skills.description: Examine DESIGN.md for incorrect tokens, missing states, and different instructions for the same item. Use before interface implementation or after changes.

skills.name: update-design-md
skills.title: Design file changes
skills.description: Change specified selections in DESIGN.md. Use when the developer changes design data or instructions for an interface.

skills.name: apply-design
skills.title: Interface implementation
skills.description: Use DESIGN.md to change an interface. Use when a developer must have components, layouts, or styles from the recorded design data.

skills.name: review-design-drift
skills.title: Design drift inspection
skills.description: Compare an interface with DESIGN.md. Use to find differences in tokens, components, states, and responsive behavior.

skills.name: define-typography
skills.title: Typography data
skills.description: Set typography roles and font sources in DESIGN.md. Use for text hierarchy, font selection, or font changes.

skills.name: define-color-system
skills.title: Color data
skills.description: Set color roles and modes in DESIGN.md. Use for color selection, contrast pairs, or theme changes.

skills.name: define-responsive-layout
skills.title: Responsive layout data
skills.description: Set layout behavior in DESIGN.md. Use for viewport limits, breakpoints, spacing, or content sequence changes.

skills.name: define-interaction-states
skills.title: Interaction state data
skills.description: Set component states in DESIGN.md. Use for focus, hover, loading, error, selection, and motion behavior.

skills.name: review-accessibility
skills.title: Accessibility inspection
skills.description: Examine accessibility instructions or an interface. Use for contrast, keyboard operation, labels, focus, and responsive content.

skills.name: export-design-tokens
skills.title: Design token export
skills.description: Export DESIGN.md tokens as CSS, DTCG JSON, or Tailwind theme data. Use to connect design values to a project token source.

skills.name: enforce-design
skills.title: Design code checks
skills.description: Add design code checks from DESIGN.md to a project and its continuous integration. Use to stop changes with colors, sizes, fonts, or effects that the design file does not permit.
